answers.core: This can be provided by an add-on, but until [shader templates](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8366) are implemented, usability will suffer. Also, I'd wager this is a common enough use case to warrant being in core. There are a lot of 3D pixel art games out there that have noisy pixels at a distance with no cheap way of resolving it :slightly_smiling_face:
answers.workaround: This can be worked around with a custom shader, but this makes the 3D pipeline a lot more complex if you have to use it for every material in your level (as opposed to simply ticking a checkbox in BaseMaterial3D). You'll generally want this option to be enabled on most of your materials (if not all).

title: Add an option to use smooth pixel texture filtering in BaseMaterial3D
